from pickle import dump, load
from PyQt5.uic import loadUi
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication, QTableWidgetItem ,QMessageBox
from numpy import array
from math import sqrt


def valider():
    xd=win.xd.text()
    yd=win.yd.text()
    win.loc.setText("("+xd+","+yd+")")


def occurence_id(ch): #premier methode taille connu
    global n
    f1=open("bateaux.dat","rb")
    occ=0
    for i in range(n):
        e=load(f1)
        if ch==e["id"]:
            occ+=1
    f1.close()
    return occ

def occurence_cord(y,x): #2eme methode taille inconnu
    f1=open("bateaux.dat","rb")
    eof=False
    occ=0
    while not eof :
        try:
            e=load(f1)
            if e["x"]==x and e["y"]==y:
                occ+=1
        except:
            eof=True
    f1.close()
    return occ

def verif():
    id=win.id.text()
    x=win.lat.text()
    y=win.longi.text()
    type=win.type.currentIndex()
    xd=win.xd.text()
    yd=win.yd.text()
    if len(id)!=4 or id.isdigit()==False or occurence_id(id)>0:
        QMessageBox.critical(win,"erreur","id invalide")
        return False
    if x=="" or y=="" or (yd==y and xd==x) or occurence_cord(y,x)>0:
        QMessageBox.critical(win,"erreur","verfier votre cordonnees")
        return False
    if type==0:
        QMessageBox.critical(win,"erreur","type invalide")
        return False
    return True


def ajouter():
    global n
    f1=open("bateaux.dat","ab")
    if verif():
        e={}
        e["id"]=win.id.text()
        e["x"]=win.lat.text()
        e["y"]=win.longi.text()
        e["type"]=win.type.currentText()
        dump(e,f1)
        n+=1
        QMessageBox.information(win,"validee","bateau ajoutee")
    f1.close()


def calcul_distance(td,n):
    xd=win.xd.text()
    yd=win.yd.text()
    f1=open("bateaux.dat","rb")
    for i in range(n):
        e=load(f1)
        d=sqrt(((float(xd)-float(e["x"]))*(float(xd)-float(e["x"]))) + ((float(yd)-float(e["y"]))*(float(yd)-float(e["y"]))))
        pospt=str(d).find(".")
        d=float(str(d)[:pospt+3])
        td[i]=d
    f1.close()



def affiche_bateaux():
    global n,td
    calcul_distance(td,n)
    f1=open("bateaux.dat","rb")
    i=0
    win.table1.setRowCount(0)
    for i in range(n):
        e=load(f1)
        win.table1.insertRow(i)
        win.table1.setItem(i,0,QTableWidgetItem(e["id"]))
        win.table1.setItem(i,1,QTableWidgetItem(e["x"]))
        win.table1.setItem(i,2,QTableWidgetItem(e["y"]))
        win.table1.setItem(i,3,QTableWidgetItem(e["type"]))
        win.table1.setItem(i,4,QTableWidgetItem(str((td[i]))))
        i+=1
    f1.close()




def transfert_f1_tc(tc,n):
    f1=open("bateaux.dat","rb")
    for i in range(n):
        e=load(f1)
        tc[i]={}
        tc[i]=e
    f1.close()





def tri(td,tc,n):
    for i in range(1,n):
        tmp1=td[i]
        tmp2=tc[i]
        j=i
        while (j>0) and (td[j-1]>tmp1):
            td[j]=td[j-1]
            tc[j]=tc[j-1]
            j-=1
        td[j]=tmp1
        tc[j]=tmp2




def transfert_tc_f2(tc,n):
    f2=open("distance.txt","w")
    for i in range(n):
        ch="("+str(tc[i]["x"])+","+str(tc[i]["y"])+")"
        f2.write(ch+"\n")
    f2.close()



def affiche_distance(): 
    global n,tc,td
    transfert_f1_tc(tc,n)
    tri(td,tc,n)
    transfert_tc_f2(tc,n)
    f2=open("distance.txt","r")
    win.list1.clear()
    for i in range(n):
        ch=f2.readline().strip()
        win.list1.addItem(ch)
    f2.close()
        





n=0
tc=array([{}]*1000)
td=array([float()]*1000)
app = QApplication([])
win = loadUi("interface_radar.ui")
win.show()
win.btn1.clicked.connect(valider)
win.btn2.clicked.connect(ajouter)
win.btn3.clicked.connect(affiche_bateaux)
win.btn4.clicked.connect(affiche_distance)
app.exec_()
